PK primary key UQ unique field ● required ○ nullable
crow’s foot = many; double bar = one; orange = documented application link
are application-level IDs. Supabase currently declares no database foreign-key constraints for this scope.
All 29 parent-scope tables and their live fields are shown. The short orange routes use isolated lanes and end exactly at their notation.
Long, cross-functional application IDs are highlighted in orange but intentionally not routed across other tables. This keeps the full-schema master readable.
